claims.content: The Customer selects a bid amount and clicks the 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button to place a bid.
The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer successfully places a bid on an auction item.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer is on an auction item and chooses to place a bid.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer's bid for the auction item has been placed.
in_scope_actions: Place a bid on an auction item

claims.content: Before a bid is allowed, the system checks the bidder's sign-in status. If the bidder has not signed in when attempting to place a bid (e.g., clicking QuickBid or anywhere in the product module), the system takes the bidder directly to the sign-in page. After completing the sign-in process, the user is delivered to the Product Details page of the item.
If the Customer has unresolved (i.e., unpaid) auction winnings greater than 7 days old, the system will not allow the Customer to bid. Exit: the bid attempt is prevented.

If the Customer is subject to the escalation policy (failing to pay more than three times in a twelve-month period, unless less than 10% of total winnings), the Customer cannot bid again until a Customer Service Rep removes the account from Review Status. Exit: the Customer remains unable to bid until that Review Status is removed.

If the bid confirmation popup dialog is shown, the Customer can cancel the bid confirmation by clicking the 'CANCEL' button in the popup dialog. Exit: the bid confirmation is cancelled and no bid is placed.

missing_aspects: Handling of bid validation failures (e.g., bid below the current bid/increment or auction no longer available) is not covered by the provided evidence.
Numbered main_flow step anchors for these exception branches are not available from the provided context.

claims.content: The Customer's bid is placed successfully and processed by the system.
The Customer remains on the Product Details page after the bid is placed; the system does not redirect to a confirmation or checkout page.
The Item Bid History table on the Product Details page is updated to include the new bid entry with Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User? status.
The Current High Bid is dynamically updated without requiring a page refresh.
The bid is recorded with a timestamp precise to 1/100th of a second.
Customer
Diverges from the main flow by providing an alternate entry point: the Customer places a bid directly from the catalog view by clicking the 'QuickBid' button located under the item's price and timer.
Diverges from the main-flow entry point on the Product Details page: the Customer places a bid directly from the Category Page List View by clicking the 'QuickBid' button next to an item.

Diverges from the main-flow bid-submission step (where the Customer clicks the 'Place Single Bid' button and the system displays a bid confirmation popup): instead, the Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button, which uses the value in the 'QuickBid Amount' field and places a single bid adding the stated increment to the last bid.
Diverges from the main-flow single-bid path: the Customer uses the SmartBid capability (proxy bidding/max bidding) instead of placing a single bid.
Diverges from the main-flow bid-submission step: the Customer can access SmartBid bidding options via the 'SmartBid' button located on the Category Page List View.

Diverges from the main-flow bid-submission timing: when overtime bidding is ON and a bid is placed within the time extension window (e.g., five seconds before the scheduled end), the auction automatically extends by the configured duration (e.g., 20 seconds); if another bid is placed during the extension, it extends again for the same duration.
The Customer is signed in to the auction site.
The Customer's account contains the required minimum information needed to place a bid.
The Customer has agreed to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement.
If overtime bidding is enabled, the auction may remain open after the scheduled closing time when a bid is placed near the end.
Customer clicks the 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button.

The system displays a Bid Confirmation Pop-up asking for verification of the amount and card details; it states the bid amount, bid type, and payment method, and includes 'Yes, Place [Type] Bid' and 'Cancel' buttons.
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking the 'Yes, Place [Type] Bid' button in the popup.
The system processes the bid, and the Customer remains on the Product Details page.
The system records the bid in the Item Bid History table, displaying the bidder's Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User? status.
The system updates the Current High Bid dynamically for all items without requiring a page refresh.

quality_flags.detail: [altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 3 says it diverges from the main-flow bid-amount selection step where the Customer selects an amount from the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' dropdowns, but main_flow contains no such step. Main_flow goes from clicking 'Place Single Bid' directly to a confirmation popup; the popup only states the bid amount and does not have the Customer select from dropdowns. The attachment point is therefore nonexistent/out-of-range. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (recovery/exit behavior after the QuickBid Now divergence is not supported by cited evidence))

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 2 says it diverges from the main-flow entry point on the Product Details page, but main_flow has no 'entry point' step and the described action takes place on the Category Page List View. The attachment point is therefore nonexistent/logically unrelated to the PDP-based main flow. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence that the main-flow bid submission occurs on the Product Details page and that the Category Page List View QuickBid action bypasses navigation to that page.))

[trigger_preconditions_coverage] The Trigger requires the Customer to choose a bid amount and click a Place Bid button, which is only possible if the auction item is currently in an open/accepting-bids state. Preconditions does not assert this; it only contains a conditional business rule that the auction may remain open after its scheduled closing time when overtime bidding is enabled. Therefore the precondition needed to initiate the Trigger is missing.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 4 states it diverges from the 'main-flow single-bid path' by using SmartBid, but main_flow step 1 already presents 'Place SmartBid' and 'Place Single Bid' as two button options within the same flow, and no later main_flow step defines a separate single-bid path. The stated divergence point therefore does not map to an existing main_flow step/branch.

[altflow_diverge_points] Alternative flow claim 5 says it diverges from the 'main-flow bid-submission step', but the described behavior is an alternate entry from the Category Page List View via a SmartBid button. That is an entry-point variation, not a divergence at the bid-submission step, so the claimed attachment point is logically unrelated/out-of-range.

inconsistency_hints: The Trigger claims the Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button, but Main Flow step 1 says the Customer clicks the 'Place Single Bid' button. The main_flow coverage notes that QuickBid is an alternative flow, not the main dropdown-selection flow. This means Main Flow step 1 does not continue from the Trigger; it starts a different action. The trigger evidence also lacks the required main-path initiating action of selecting a bid amount and clicking 'Place Single Bid'/'Place SmartBid'.

The trigger requires the Customer to select a bid amount and place a bid. This is only valid if the auction item is currently open and accepting bids. The preconditions list customer/account states (signed in, required minimum info, Terms acceptance) but do not assert that external item/auction state, so the preconditions do not fully cover the trigger.

The trigger explicitly allows the Customer to click either 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid'. Main Flow step 1 continues only with 'Place Single Bid', leaving the SmartBid initiating action without a corresponding continuation in the main flow.

Alternative flow claim 3 references a main-flow 'bid-amount selection step' where the Customer selects an amount from the 'Your SmartBid' or 'Your Single Bid' dropdowns, but main_flow contains no such step. The main flow proceeds from clicking 'Place Single Bid' directly to the confirmation popup, so the divergence point does not exist.

Alternative flow claim 5 references the 'main-flow Product Details entry point' but main_flow does not define an entry point as a step, and the described SmartBid access is on the Category Page List View. This is not an existing main_flow attachment point.

Alternative flow claim 1 references the 'main-flow entry point on the Product Details page' but main_flow has no entry-point step, and the claim then says the bid is placed from the catalog view. The divergence point is ambiguous and not anchored to an existing main_flow step.
